pm_exper_user_3948_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) For casual outings with friends, you could pair chinos with a polo shirt and layer on a cardigan for style. Add boat shoes or loafers for a relaxed yet refined touch that works in most settings.
(b) Since you like wearing jeans and t‑shirts and you also enjoy karaoke nights now and then, you could mix in a classic tee with your favorite denim and add a fun patterned overshirt for flair. Comfortable sneakers will keep it easy to move around in if the night turns lively.
(c) Given that your go-to look is often a t‑shirt with jeans, you might try swapping in a quality plain tee tucked slightly into straight-leg denim, finished with loafers or low-profile sneakers. Layering with an unstructured blazer or open shirt can give it a smart casual twist without sacrificing comfort.
(d) Since you usually stick to jeans and t‑shirts, you could upgrade the look for casual outings by pairing dark, slim-fit jeans with a well-fitted graphic tee and a lightweight bomber jacket. Add clean sneakers and a simple watch to keep it comfortable yet put-together.
